sources.snippet: Whisper encoder on the AMD XDNA1 NPU (Ryzen AI, Phoenix) under Linux — open toolchain only: XRT, MLIR-AIE/IRON, peano. Includes an HTTP service speaking whisper.cpp's contract. - drakosha/whisper-xdna

sources.title: AMD XDNA™ Architecture
sources.snippet: AMD XDNA is a spatial dataflow NPU architecture consisting of a tiled array of AI Engine processors. Each AI Engine tile includes a vector processor, a scalar processor, and local data and program memories.

sources.title: AMD XDNA - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: XDNA is a microarchitecture for deep learning processor developed by AMD. It is designed to handle Machine learning (ML)-related tasks, such as artificial intelligence (AI) software. It is based on Xilinx technology, which AMD acquired in 2022. XDNA-based silicon designs are incorporated into the company's Ryzen AI -branded processors where it supplements the Zen CPU and RDNA GPU on the same ...

sources.title: AI Tracker: new AI models and leaks, the moment they appear
sources.snippet: AI Tracker watches model APIs, docs, app bundles, leaderboards and leak accounts around the clock. The moment a new model or leak shows up, it pings Discord, X, your inbox and your browser.

sources.title: Scottcjn/open-xdna: Open-source bring-up - GitHub
sources.snippet: The first-generation XDNA1 NPU — "Phoenix" / "Hawk Point" — in millions of Ryzen laptops, brought up on Linux with 100% open source. Models running on the silicon. Custom vector kernels hand-authored in the AIE ISA.
